episodeTitle: More fake shows on the way, as Meta’s Muse gets into podcasting
text: From our free daily newsletter, the latest from podnews.net with Gamut Podcast Network. Meta's Muse has only been available since September, but it appears that this new AI assistant is capable of researching content for podcasts, recording podcasts using artificial voices, and hosting podcasts on its own servers. We've found more than 20 shows which are already being hosted on Meta's platform, including one from a man who calls himself Charles Mayfield, who says he runs a podcast network and is even partnered with a university for internships. But is he real? We take a deep dive into how Muse ... [truncated]
